annotations.title: Pick between two or three products

description: For two or three products, which one the written buy-or-wait rules put ahead, or that neither is ahead, optionally for a shopper who owns a device or uses iPhone or Android, with a budget. Each product comes with its verdict (buy_now, wait, skip, check_fit or not_enough_data), its fit with the phone given, today's retailer price and the reasons, each with its source and how sure iDevice is. A product that does not work with the phone given goes last; then the verdict decides, then the fit answer. Price alone does not put one ahead. The same comparison as the decision card on idevice.com. No model is involved.

budget_usd.description: A price ceiling in US dollars

owned_device_slug.description: A product_slug of a device the shopper already owns, e.g. 'iphone-17'

owned_platform.description: The phone platform the shopper uses
